rule: International students may take part in work-study (勤工助学) activities but may not take up employment, run a business or other for-profit activities
legal_basis: Order No. 42 (2017) Measures on Admission and Training of International Students, art. 30
note: Detailed work-study rules to be issued separately by the education authority with other departments.

rule: Universities may organise teaching internships and social practice for international students according to the teaching plan; locations must follow national rules

A holder of a study residence permit who wants off-campus work-study or internship needs the university's consent, then applies to the public security exit-entry authority to annotate the place and period on the permit; without the annotation off-campus work-study or internship is not allowed
legal_basis: Regulations on Administration of Exit and Entry of Foreigners (State Council, 2013), art. 22
note: Exact text read on two university-hosted copies (BIT, PKU), in force since 01.09.2013. gov.cn originals returned an error on 2 tries.

rule: Master's or above graduates of Chinese universities may get a work permit within 1 year of graduation without work experience (average 80+/B+, job related to major, local average pay, quota). No national route for bachelor graduates; Shanghai admits bachelors in listed zones
legal_basis: MOHRSS/MFA/MOE Notice 2017 No. 3 on outstanding foreign graduates
note: Gov.cn original not opened; status after 2021 not confirmed.

rule: Non-local students may not take up paid or unpaid employment or start a business except as allowed below
legal_basis: ImmD conditions of stay for students

rule: On-campus part-time work up to 20 hours per week (unused hours do not carry over); exchange students excluded
legal_basis: ImmD conditions of stay for students
note: Applies to full-time locally-accredited programmes at degree level (standard rules).

rule: Summer jobs 1 June to 31 August with no limit on hours or location; exchange students excluded
legal_basis: ImmD conditions of stay for students

rule: Study-related internship endorsed by the institution, up to one academic year or one-third of the programme, whichever is shorter; no limit on pay, hours, employer or location
legal_basis: ImmD conditions of stay for students
note: For undergraduate-level and above programmes of at least one academic year.

rule: Non-exchange full-time students of locally-accredited undergraduate+ programmes (>= 1 academic year) are temporarily exempt from the work restrictions, within limit of stay or the No Objection Letter period
note: Start and end dates of the relaxation are not stated on the ImmD page.

rule: IANG: non-local graduates of full-time locally-accredited bachelor+ programmes applying within 6 months of graduation get 24 months' stay without a job offer and may change employers freely
note: After 6 months a degree-level job offer at market pay is needed. Not open to nationals of Afghanistan, Cuba, DPRK.

rule: A foreign student who breaks work-study rules by working beyond the permitted job scope or time limit is in illegal employment
legal_basis: Exit and Entry Administration Law (2012), art. 43(3)
note: Text read on a Shenzhen University copy of the law.

rule: Illegal employment: fine of 5,000-20,000 CNY; serious cases: 5-15 days detention plus the same fine; deported foreigners may not re-enter for 10 years, repatriated ones for 5 years
legal_basis: Exit and Entry Administration Law (2012), art. 80 and art. 81
note: Wording read on the Tsinghua international students page, which quotes the law without article numbers; numbers are from the law structure.
